template_rules: Generated families (WCCMSG texts) are built from the game database by template_regex(): split the template on %s, %d and %%; %s becomes a lazy group (.*?), %d becomes -?\d+, %% becomes a literal percent sign; a group is named after the role's argument (see roles.args) or s<N>/n<N> otherwise, and a repeated name becomes a non-capturing group; the first letter of the text matches either case ([Xx]); literal text is re.escape()d; a trailing run of %s is dropped and replaced by an optional (?:\s.*)? tail.

context.room_title: A line equal to a room name from the game data; not a regex.
context.room_desc: Any unmatched line after a room title and before the next room_* pattern; a context rule, not a regex.
